info.name: Saas Store API
info.description: Schema-per-tenant RBAC API. Orders: POST /orders (optional { addressId }; uses the given address when it belongs to the caller, else the caller's default delivery address, and 400 with no writes when neither is usable) atomically turns the caller's cart into an order (empty cart / missing or inactive product / insufficient stock -> 400; success snapshots lines, decrements stock and clears cart lines); GET /orders and GET /orders/:id scope to the owner unless the caller has orders:manage (non-owner Get -> 404 to avoid enumeration); PATCH /orders/:id/cancel restocks (owners may cancel PENDING/CONFIRMED, manage PENDING/CONFIRMED/PROCESSING/SHIPPED); PATCH /orders/:id/return (needs orders:return) lets the owner or a manager move a DELIVERED order to RETURN_REQUESTED; PATCH /orders/:id/status is manager-only and follows PENDING->CONFIRMED->PROCESSING->SHIPPED->DELIVERED, with CANCELLED reachable from any non-terminal state and RETURN_REQUESTED->RETURNED (restocks) or RETURN_REQUESTED->DELIVERED (rejected). Flow: run `Register Store` first (public self-serve signup, auto-sets tenant_slug + owner tokens), or `Login Platform` to get {{platform_token}} for the Platform folder. Set `tenant_slug` to target a tenant; Users/Roles/Permissions/Products/Categories folders auto-send `x-tenant-slug`. Login stores access_token/refresh_token; Refresh rotates them (old refresh token is revoked). POST /auth/logout clears the caller's stored jti (invalidating the refresh token) and /auth/logout/platform does the same for a platform session; GET /health is the public platform probe (db + r2). List Users/Roles/Permissions/Tenants/Products/Categories auto-set user_id/role_id/permission_id/tenant_id/product_id/category_id (list/upload also set image_id). The Addresses folder is own-scoped and its List/Create requests set address_id. Every folder inherits the collection-level Bearer {{access_token}} except Auth (no auth) and Platform (Bearer {{platform_token}}; tenant tokens are rejected on platform routes with 403). Custom role keys must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$ ; uppercase keys are reserved system roles (create/rename to them -> 409, rename/delete of system roles -> 409). Create Permission key must be a valid permission key (409 if already seeded). Products: SKU must match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$ (duplicate -> 400), optional categoryId must reference an existing category (unknown -> 400), images are jpeg/png/webp/gif multipart `file` field (quota + count limits -> 413/400). Categories: each tenant is seeded with 8 base categories on provision/re-seed; slug is auto-derived from name when omitted and must be unique (duplicate -> 400), deleting a category nulls products.categoryId. Cart: each authenticated tenant user has one owner-scoped cart; GET /cart returns the enriched cart (empty synthetic cart when none, no row written). POST /cart/items merges by incrementing (needs a product_id from List Products); PATCH /cart/items/:productId sets an absolute quantity (0 is not a remove, use DELETE); DELETE /cart/items/:productId removes a line; DELETE /cart clears lines but keeps the cart. Requires cart:read/create/update/delete (seeded for CUSTOMER/ADMIN/STORE_OWNER/SUPER_ADMIN and backfilled on boot). Add/update validate isActive + stock (1..99 per line, 100 distinct lines max; over -> 400), and reads flag stale lines with isAvailable/availableStock without deleting them. Dashboard: GET /dashboard/stats (needs orders:manage) returns the store-owner cards in one tenant-scoped payload - totalOrders, fulfilledOrders (DELIVERED), pendingOrders (PENDING), totalPaid (sum of total where paymentStatus=PAID), waitingAmount (sum of total where paymentStatus=UNPAID) and customers (users whose role is CUSTOMER).

request.description: Clears the caller's stored jti, so the refresh token is revoked. Send the tenant access token plus x-tenant-slug.
Platform variant: clears the platform user's stored jti. Requires the platform access token (tenant tokens are rejected on platform routes with 403).

request.description: Own addresses only, default first then oldest. Requires addresses:read.
Own addresses only; a foreign or unknown id returns 404. Requires addresses:read.
Your first address becomes the default automatically; isDefault:true clears the previous default. Country is stored uppercase. At most 20 addresses (400 when exceeded). Requires addresses:create.
Edits your own address. isDefault is not accepted here (it is rejected as an unknown field); use Set Default Address. Requires addresses:update.
Promotes your own address to the single default, clearing the previous one. Requires addresses:update.
Deletes your own address; when it was the default the oldest remaining address is promoted. Requires addresses:delete.

Optional body { addressId }: uses the given address (must belong to the caller) or, when omitted, the caller's default address. With no usable delivery address the request fails with 400 and nothing is written. Builds the order from the caller's cart in one atomic transaction; empty cart / missing or inactive product / insufficient stock -> 400. Requires orders:create.
Customers see their own orders; orders:manage sees all orders and may filter by status/userId. Requires orders:read.
Non-owners without orders:manage get 404 (order ids are not enumerable). Requires orders:read.
Restocks every line. Owners may cancel PENDING/CONFIRMED; orders:manage may cancel any non-terminal state. Terminal states return 400. Requires orders:cancel.
Manager-only. Allowed transitions: PENDING→CONFIRMED, CONFIRMED→PROCESSING, PROCESSING→SHIPPED, SHIPPED→DELIVERED, and any non-terminal→CANCELLED (which restocks). Requires orders:manage.
Moves a DELIVERED order you own (or, with orders:manage, any order) to RETURN_REQUESTED. Any other status -> 400. Requires orders:return; a non-owner without orders:manage gets 404.

Store-owner cards in one tenant-scoped payload: totalOrders, fulfilledOrders (DELIVERED), pendingOrders (PENDING), totalPaid, waitingAmount, customers, storageUsedBytes, storageCapacityBytes, schemaSizeBytes (Postgres pg_total_relation_size; display-only, 0 on failure), schemaCapacityBytes (TENANT_DB_CAPACITY_BYTES; display-only). Requires orders:manage.

Preview only: computes the discount for the code against your current cart subtotal without consuming usage. Returns code, discountType, discountValue, subtotal, discountAmount, total. Requires coupons:validate.
Codes are trimmed, uppercased, matched against ^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_-]*$ and unique per tenant. discountType is PERCENTAGE or FIXED_AMOUNT; maxDiscountAmount is percentage-only. Requires coupons:create.
Paginated: { data, total, page, limit }. Optional isActive and code filters. Requires coupons:read.
Requires coupons:read.
Partial update. Changing the code of a redeemed coupon is rejected (400). Requires coupons:update.
Activates or deactivates a coupon. Requires coupons:update.
Returns 409 when the coupon has redemptions (usageCount > 0); deactivate it instead. Requires coupons:delete.
Creates a Stripe PaymentIntent for one of your orders (destination charge). Returns the client secret. Any authenticated tenant user may call it.
Platform-only Stripe webhook. Verifies the stripe-signature header against the raw request body; do not send a JSON body from here. Handles payment_intent.*, charge.refunded and refund.* events.
Returns the connected account status for the resolved tenant. Requires payments:manage.
Starts/populates Stripe Connect onboarding and returns the onboarding link. Requires payments:manage.
Public storefront metadata for the resolved tenant: { name, slug, currency }. Needs a tenant identifier (x-tenant-slug / x-tenant-id / subdomain).
Store owner view: { currency, pendingRequest, history } (last 10 requests). Requires the STORE_OWNER role.
Requests a store currency change. 400 when it matches the current currency; 409 when a pending request already exists. Requires the STORE_OWNER role.
Cancels one of the tenant pending requests (409 when it is not pending, 404 for a foreign id). Requires the STORE_OWNER role.

query.description: Filter by status: PENDING | APPROVED | REJECTED | CANCELLED

request.description: Lists currency change requests across tenants, newest first, each with a tenant summary. SUPER_ADMIN only.
Applies the requested currency to the tenant and marks the request APPROVED. 409 when already reviewed. SUPER_ADMIN only.
Marks the request REJECTED; reviewNote is required (400 when blank). 409 when already reviewed. SUPER_ADMIN only.
Every tenant with Stripe/pause flags: { id, name, slug, subdomain, status, stripeAccountId, paymentsPaused, payoutsPaused }. SUPER_ADMIN only.
Platform Stripe account + balance for the admin overview, or { account: null, balance: null, error }. SUPER_ADMIN only.
Tenant + connected account status, balance (when connected) and payout schedule. SUPER_ADMIN only.
Paginated tenant payment rows ({ data, total, page, limit }); limit clamps to 1..100. SUPER_ADMIN only.
Stripe payouts for the tenant connected account ({ data, hasMore, nextCursor }). 409 when the store is not connected. SUPER_ADMIN only.
Pauses or resumes payments for the tenant; returns { paymentsPaused, payoutsPaused }. SUPER_ADMIN only.
Pauses or resumes payouts (Switch Stripe schedule to/from manual). 409 when the store is not connected. SUPER_ADMIN only.
Public platform probe: reports db + r2 and an ok/degraded status. No auth or tenant header required.
